delta.label: Jezero - Delta Front
delta.blurb: Wildcat Ridge, Skinner Ridge and Kukaklek (Hidden Harbor) - the current Perseverance delta-front sampling area.

amalik.label: Jezero - Amalik outcrops
amalik.blurb: Shuyak and Mageik sampling stops at the Amalik outcrop - same delta-front unit (NHjf2) as the Delta Front scenario: different samples and route geometry, not a different environment.

gale.label: Gale - Yellowknife Bay
gale.blurb: Rocknest, the Shaler viewpoint, the John Klein & Cumberland drill sites and the sol-324 departure - Curiosity's Yellowknife Bay campaign inside Gale crater. Geometric planning demo only.
